periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Slanted at approximately 60 degrees downward relative to the horizontal axis of the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering towards the inferior margin near the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth, wide U-shaped curvature on the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, occupying roughly 40 percent of the visible dorsal-ventral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with a gap approximately twice the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Generally rounded and semicircular with minor tufted irregularities at the dorsal-most points.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-red pigmentation of the fur on the hind limbs and feet, contrasting with the deep black of the forelimbs.
